# ClawHub publish registry — one skill directory per line.
# Listing here is the explicit opt-in: merges to main auto-publish a listed
# skill when its SKILL.md version is new on ClawHub; unlisted skills are
# never published, even by manual dispatch. Lives beside the publish
# workflow on purpose: one file to read to know what ships.
